shop.title: SCUTOONS Shop
shop.description:
Discover our exclusive Limited-Editions with your favorite SCUTOONS characters.

Each piece is carefully crafted and designed to bring a smile to your face. Browse our

collection and find the perfect piece for your SCUTOONS collection!

account.claim_membership_reminder: Reminder: If you claim your membership, we can send you email updates and you can make changes to your membership! After all, you purchased this QR code.
account.no_membership_message: No membership found. Please scan a QR code to activate your account.
account.login_intro: Sign in with your email. We send you a one-time code, no password.
account.code_sent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it here or tap the link in the mail.
account.login_failed: That did not work. Check the code and try again.
account.network_error: Can't reach the SCUTOONS server. Try again later.
account.claim_with_login: Sign in to add code {code} to your inventory.
account.access_none: No code in your account yet

account.signup_intro: Create your account with your email. We send you a one-time code, no password.

membership_blocker.signed_in_hint: Your account has no membership yet. Scan the QR code of your SCUTOONS item to add it.

creator.title: SCUTOONS Creator
creator.sign_in_text: Sign in with your email to open the creator editor.
creator.no_access_text: The creator editor is for SCUTOONS creators. Your account ({email}) doesn't have the creator role yet – ask an admin to add it.
creator.new_chapter_created: Chapter {number} created as a draft in every locale and added to the season. Save it to keep it.

creator.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
creator.restore_confirm: Restore version #{id} as a new draft of {locale}?
creator.recover_stale: They were made on an older version.
